name: Ariel Ekgren

affiliations.role: Research scientist and tech lead; lead author of GPT-SW3

bio: Ariel Ekgren is a research scientist and tech lead at AI Sweden who works on large language models for Swedish and the Nordic languages. Ekgren is the corresponding author of the GPT-SW3 papers, which describe a family of decoder-only models trained on about 320 billion tokens.
known_for: Large language models for Nordic languages
Tech lead for language models at AI Sweden
